text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day off, Smart Falcon brings me to a pastry shop in a department store.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ What's the first thing that comes to mind when you think "cute"? Desserts, of course!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can't become a top Umadol without extensive research, sooo…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Without further ado, let's start investiga… Hm?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Is that who I think it is?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello. This appears to be what is known as a "coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I thought that was you, Bourbon! Are you here to buy a dessert?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Sweet snacks are an efficient way to replenish energy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This area has a high concentration of specialty stores, so I've come to examine the quality items available here.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: In other words, research! That's why I'm here too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Since we're both here, why don't we eat together? What do you say, Bourbon? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Request approved. Collaboration on the same objective will further increase results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For the first operation, I propose we consume all forty-two items on sale at this store.
choice_data_list: Th-think of how that'll affect your weight!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Buuut! If we're going to complete our research successfully, we've gotta put our bodies on the line!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, please, Trainer! Say it's okay!
choice_data_list: Sorry, but there's no way I can allow that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Laaaame! Come ooon, Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I am also disappointed. However, considering the potential effects of rapid weight gain, it is a rational decision.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If I may propose an alternative, why don't we gather visual data through "window research"?
choice_data_list: I don't see a problem with that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see… Appearances sell a dessert just as much as taste!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, Bourbon! You must be really motivated to find a work-around just like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna see this research on cuteness through to the very end! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm not leaving until my Umasta is full of dessert appearance reviews!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the two head toward the pastry shop with determined faces.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you! Isn't that great, Bourbon? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …All digestive organs have transitioned from standby to active mode.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Let us begin our research immediately. The final goal is to conquer every store on this floor!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Your determination is so strong, I can feel it in the air!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Buuut… my drive for "cuteness" is not about to be beat! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna eat until my Umasta is totally full of reviews!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the two "research" so many desserts I lose count.
